title: Editor Browser Live Backend Corpus Smoke Checklist

items.label: Capture current Project Control, Core, Editor, and Backend heads, working agreements, prior browser smoke evidence, and default-corpus surfaces before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Exact commit IDs, clean git status, AGENTS.md boundaries, prior browser smoke evidence, and Backend default corpus fixture IDs are reviewed before Editor edits.

items.label: Confirm the corpus smoke belongs in Editor without moving Backend server behavior, Core semantics, or Project Control truth responsibilities.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor app/test surfaces, Backend HTTP server surfaces, and Core fixture/adapter boundaries show the smoke can use public or test-only harness surfaces without ownership drift.

items.label: Write an Editor-owned failing retained-evidence test for the browser/live Backend corpus smoke fixture.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor retained-evidence test fails before implementation because the corpus smoke evidence fixture does not yet exist.

items.label: Implement the minimal browser smoke runner needed to open the default live Backend corpus through rendered Editor routes, or record an exact blocker.
items.evidenceTarget: The Editor diff keeps production responsibility boundaries intact and distinguishes default-corpus browser evidence from the previous one-document smoke.

items.label: Run focused and full owner repository gates after the corpus smoke is in place or after the blocker is recorded.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor focused corpus smoke, retained evidence test, npm run check, and any required Backend/Core no-change evidence are recorded.

items.label: Register the corpus smoke evidence or blocker in Project Control without promoting broad FlowDoc truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-editor-browser-live-backend-corpus-smoke-2026-08-27 records the commit, checks, supported claim or blocker, risks, and intentionally unpromoted truth.
